scope: Last 157 sorted profile-settings UIDs from installed Rocket 1.4.0.705 inventory
qualification: Plain-language interpretation of installed UI schemas/help and ordinary slicer concepts. No default, safe limit, physical result, or firmware behavior is inferred.

profile-settings:insetFOuterCount.meaning: Number of continuous-fiber shell loops reinforcing the outside contour rather than holes.
profile-settings:insetFOuterCount.when_to_change: Change when the outside surface needs a different reinforcement layout.
profile-settings:insetFOuterCount.effect: More loops reserve more room for fiber and add fiber use and print time; fewer leave more room for plastic and infill.
profile-settings:insetFOuterCount.caution: Requires the correct composite tool/material and a verified fiber path. This is not permission to run an empty or leaking fiber head.
profile-settings:insetFOuterCount.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:insetXFCalcOrder.meaning: Chooses whether fiber-shell paths are calculated from holes or from the outer contour first.
profile-settings:insetXFCalcOrder.when_to_change: Use when competing fiber loops around holes and the outside need a different placement priority.
profile-settings:insetXFCalcOrder.effect: Holes first prioritizes hole-side shells; Contour first starts from the exterior. This concerns calculation priority, not a guaranteed visible print order.
profile-settings:insetXFCalcOrder.caution: Inspect the actual generated paths; narrow walls may not fit every requested loop.

options.label: Holes first
options.meaning: Prioritizes calculating the fiber shell from hole boundaries outward.

options.label: Contour first
options.meaning: Prioritizes calculating the fiber shell from the outer contour inward.

profile-settings:insetXFCalcOrder.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:insetXFEWMM.meaning: Requested laid-composite line width for fiber-shell paths.
profile-settings:insetXFEWMM.when_to_change: Change only with evidence that the current composite line geometry needs adjustment.
profile-settings:insetXFEWMM.effect: A larger requested width changes path spacing and coverage; a smaller width packs paths more tightly.
profile-settings:insetXFEWMM.caution: Requires the correct composite tool/material and a verified fiber path. This is not permission to run an empty or leaking fiber head. A width entry is a requested geometry, not proof that the nozzle/material can produce it reliably.
profile-settings:insetXFEWMM.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:insetXFExtrusionFPercen.meaning: Fiber feed length expressed as a percentage of the planned path length.
profile-settings:insetXFExtrusionFPercen.when_to_change: Adjust only during a controlled fiber-layup calibration after feed mechanics are sound.
profile-settings:insetXFExtrusionFPercen.effect: Installed help says reducing feed increases fiber tension; increasing feed reduces tension. It is not the plastic flow multiplier.
profile-settings:insetXFExtrusionFPercen.caution: Requires the correct composite tool/material and a verified fiber path. This is not permission to run an empty or leaking fiber head. Excessive tension or slack can cause placement problems; no safe limit is established here.
profile-settings:insetXFExtrusionFPercen.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:insetXFSpeedCoeff.meaning: Multiplier applied to fiber printing speeds.
profile-settings:insetXFSpeedCoeff.when_to_change: Use to scale fiber-path speeds without editing each speed separately.
profile-settings:insetXFSpeedCoeff.effect: Increasing it requests faster fiber motion; decreasing it requests slower motion. Other limits may still cap the result.
profile-settings:insetXFSpeedCoeff.caution: Requires the correct composite tool/material and a verified fiber path. This is not permission to run an empty or leaking fiber head. A multiplier is not a verified throughput or pressure limit.
profile-settings:insetXFSpeedCoeff.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:insetXPCount.meaning: Number of plastic loops forming the internal plastic shell.
profile-settings:insetXPCount.when_to_change: Change wall structure after base flow and dimensional behavior are stable.
profile-settings:insetXPCount.effect: More loops add shell thickness, material, and print time; fewer reduce them.
profile-settings:insetXPCount.caution: Counts may be limited by available geometry; verify the actual paths rather than assuming every loop fits.
profile-settings:insetXPCount.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:insetXPEWMM.meaning: Requested extrusion width of plastic shell perimeters.
profile-settings:insetXPEWMM.when_to_change: Use for a controlled wall-geometry adjustment, not as the first response to underextrusion.
profile-settings:insetXPEWMM.effect: Increasing width requests wider shell lines and usually greater volume per unit travel; decreasing requests narrower lines.
profile-settings:insetXPEWMM.caution: A width entry is a requested geometry, not proof that the nozzle/material can produce it reliably.
profile-settings:insetXPEWMM.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:insetXPExtrusionMultP.meaning: Additional plastic-flow factor for plastic perimeters.
profile-settings:insetXPExtrusionMultP.when_to_change: Change when only perimeter paths need a measured correction after the material flow is tuned.
profile-settings:insetXPExtrusionMultP.effect: It multiplies the material flow factor. Increasing adds commanded plastic for these paths; decreasing removes it.
profile-settings:insetXPExtrusionMultP.caution: Do not use a feature multiplier to hide a clog, leak, incorrect filament diameter, or bad base flow calibration.
profile-settings:insetXPExtrusionMultP.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:insetXPInnerWithFiberCo.meaning: Number of plastic perimeters between the fiber shell and interior cellular infill.
profile-settings:insetXPInnerWithFiberCo.when_to_change: Use to change plastic separation and bonding around the inner side of fiber reinforcement.
profile-settings:insetXPInnerWithFiberCo.effect: More loops thicken the plastic region inside fiber; fewer leave more room for infill.
profile-settings:insetXPInnerWithFiberCo.caution: The short label 'P. Inner' is specific to the fiber-shell layout; it is not a different physical nozzle.
profile-settings:insetXPInnerWithFiberCo.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:insetXPOuterWithFiberCo.meaning: Number of plastic perimeters between the outside wall and the fiber shell.
profile-settings:insetXPOuterWithFiberCo.when_to_change: Use to change the plastic cover surrounding fiber near the exterior.
profile-settings:insetXPOuterWithFiberCo.effect: More loops increase plastic cover and consume more wall space; fewer bring fiber closer to the outside.
profile-settings:insetXPOuterWithFiberCo.caution: The short label 'P. Outer' describes position in the shell layout, not the tool ID.
profile-settings:insetXPOuterWithFiberCo.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:insetXPRatioToMacro.meaning: Layer height used for the thicker internal plastic-perimeter shell within a macrolayer.
profile-settings:insetXPRatioToMacro.when_to_change: Change only while checking that the chosen shell height fits the macrolayer arrangement and the nozzle.
profile-settings:insetXPRatioToMacro.effect: Increasing displayed height reduces the number of those shell layers; decreasing adds finer shell layers. The saved field is a ratio even though the editor presents height.
profile-settings:insetXPRatioToMacro.caution: Do not enter or transfer a raw ratio as though it were millimeters; use the displayed unit and inspect Z positions.
profile-settings:insetXPRatioToMacro.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:insetXPSpeed.meaning: Requested printing speed for plastic shell perimeters.
profile-settings:insetXPSpeed.when_to_change: Change after flow and temperature are stable, using a wall-speed test.
profile-settings:insetXPSpeed.effect: Faster requests reduce time but raise required flow; slower requests reduce flow demand and may change finish.
profile-settings:insetXPSpeed.caution: The request may be limited by other rules. It does not prove safe nozzle pressure.
profile-settings:insetXPSpeed.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:isSpiralVase.meaning: Selects continuous spiral construction for a hollow, single-wall object.
profile-settings:isSpiralVase.when_to_change: Use only for a suitable vase-like part rather than a normal solid or reinforced part.
profile-settings:isSpiralVase.effect: Enabled requests a continuously rising spiral wall; disabled keeps normal layer-based construction.
profile-settings:isSpiralVase.caution: Check Preview for the intended hollow result; enabling this is not a general strength or watertightness setting.
profile-settings:isSpiralVase.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:macroLayerHeight.meaning: Height of the repeated layer package containing the component microlayers.
profile-settings:macroLayerHeight.when_to_change: Change when deliberately redesigning the relationship between outer walls, internal plastic, and composite layers.
profile-settings:macroLayerHeight.effect: A larger package changes how constituent layer heights line up; a smaller package changes that schedule in the opposite direction.
profile-settings:macroLayerHeight.caution: This is not simply an ordinary slicer's single uniform layer-height field. Verify the entire layer schedule.
profile-settings:macroLayerHeight.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:minLayerTimeForSlowing.meaning: Layer-duration threshold below which Rocket requests a print-speed slowdown.
profile-settings:minLayerTimeForSlowing.when_to_change: Use when small layers do not have enough time to cool before the next layer.
profile-settings:minLayerTimeForSlowing.effect: Increasing the threshold applies slowdown to more short layers; decreasing it allows shorter layers without that slowdown.
profile-settings:minLayerTimeForSlowing.caution: Slowdown cannot guarantee adequate cooling or repair heat-damaged geometry.
profile-settings:minLayerTimeForSlowing.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:minPrintSpeedForSlowDow.meaning: Lowest speed allowed by the short-layer cooling slowdown.
profile-settings:minPrintSpeedForSlowDow.when_to_change: Change when cooling slowdown becomes too slow or cannot slow enough for small features.
profile-settings:minPrintSpeedForSlowDow.effect: A higher minimum limits how much Rocket may slow down; a lower minimum permits slower motion.
profile-settings:minPrintSpeedForSlowDow.caution: Very slow motion is not automatically safer or cleaner; validate a small-feature test.
profile-settings:minPrintSpeedForSlowDow.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:minimumFeatureSize.meaning: Smallest feature the variable-width wall generator tries to preserve.
profile-settings:minimumFeatureSize.when_to_change: Change only when tiny features disappear or create unwanted short paths.
profile-settings:minimumFeatureSize.effect: Increasing filters out more fine detail; decreasing asks the generator to keep smaller features.
profile-settings:minimumFeatureSize.caution: The slicer retaining a feature does not mean the nozzle can physically print it.
profile-settings:minimumFeatureSize.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:minimumPerimeterLength.meaning: Minimum accepted length of one continuous-fiber perimeter.
profile-settings:minimumPerimeterLength.when_to_change: Change only during an explicitly controlled short-fiber-contour investigation.
profile-settings:minimumPerimeterLength.effect: Increasing suppresses more short fiber loops; decreasing permits shorter loops.
profile-settings:minimumPerimeterLength.caution: Requires the correct composite tool/material and a verified fiber path. This is not permission to run an empty or leaking fiber head. Installed help warns that reducing it may cause short-contour layup problems.
profile-settings:minimumPerimeterLength.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:minimumWallWidth.meaning: Lower width bound requested from the variable-width wall generator.
profile-settings:minimumWallWidth.when_to_change: Use when thin-wall paths are too narrow or small features are omitted.
profile-settings:minimumWallWidth.effect: Increasing prevents narrower wall paths; decreasing lets the generator attempt narrower ones.
profile-settings:minimumWallWidth.caution: A width entry is a requested geometry, not proof that the nozzle/material can produce it reliably.
profile-settings:minimumWallWidth.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:mustGenerateFiberPerime.meaning: A switch labeled 'Fiber shell adaptive loops' under reinforced-perimeter generation.
profile-settings:mustGenerateFiberPerime.when_to_change: Leave the reviewed value unless testing this specific fiber-shell algorithm.
profile-settings:mustGenerateFiberPerime.effect: The schema proves the switch and its dependency on fiber-perimeter generation, but does not establish precisely how enabling it adapts or forces loops.
profile-settings:mustGenerateFiberPerime.caution: The raw ID suggests 'must generate' while the visible label says adaptive loops. Do not infer the Boolean polarity or a no-fiber mode.
profile-settings:mustGenerateFiberPerime.status: Exact Rocket behavior remains unverified; preview and emitted-file checks required.

profile-settings:name.when_to_change: Change to identify machine, nozzle, material, purpose, and revision clearly.
profile-settings:name.effect: Renaming improves selection and traceability; the name by itself does not alter the underlying print settings.
profile-settings:name.caution: A name containing TUNED, SAFE, or a nozzle size is not proof of validated values or the selected hardware.
profile-settings:name.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:nozzleContactRadius.meaning: Composite-nozzle contact-surface radius used by trajectory correction.
profile-settings:nozzleContactRadius.when_to_change: Change only from measured tooling geometry or a controlled correction study.
profile-settings:nozzleContactRadius.effect: Changing it alters the geometric correction applied to composite paths; it is not a filament-flow control.
profile-settings:nozzleContactRadius.caution: Do not substitute nozzle-hole diameter for contact-surface radius. Incorrect geometry can misplace paths.
profile-settings:nozzleContactRadius.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:nozzleContactRadiusExte.meaning: Composite contact radius used for the trajectory after a fiber cut.
profile-settings:nozzleContactRadiusExte.when_to_change: Change only when the post-cut correction geometry is understood and measured.
profile-settings:nozzleContactRadiusExte.effect: Changing it modifies post-cut path correction, rather than the normal plastic flow.
profile-settings:nozzleContactRadiusExte.caution: This is not a clearance or leak-prevention command. Keep the actual nozzle geometry and cutting sequence in view.
profile-settings:nozzleContactRadiusExte.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:organicTreeInterfaceSup.meaning: Pattern used in tree-support contact-interface layers.
profile-settings:organicTreeInterfaceSup.when_to_change: Change to compare interface coverage, path continuity, and removal.
profile-settings:organicTreeInterfaceSup.effect: The schema offers Zigzag, Grid, Line, and Concentric patterns; pattern choice changes the contact paths, not their validated flow.
profile-settings:organicTreeInterfaceSup.caution: Angles do not apply to every pattern. Choose from the active mode's actual list, not broader help text.

options.label: Zigzag
options.meaning: Back-and-forth fill with a zigzag layout; check how its turns and connections are generated.

options.label: Grid
options.meaning: Intersecting line families forming a grid; crossings change local path overlap.

options.label: Line
options.meaning: Parallel line paths; compare line direction and boundary connections in Preview.

options.label: Concentric
options.meaning: Nested loops following the region boundary; ordinary fill-angle settings generally do not apply.

profile-settings:organicTreeInterfaceSup.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:organicTreeSupportAutoB.caution: Automatic sizing does not prove adhesion or plate fit; inspect the full footprint.

profile-settings:treeSupportTopInterface.meaning: Conventional tree variant: Gap between neighboring lines at the top support interface.
profile-settings:treeSupportTopInterface.when_to_change: Use to balance supported-surface quality against removal effort.
profile-settings:treeSupportTopInterface.effect: Larger spacing makes the interface more open; smaller spacing adds contact coverage.
profile-settings:treeSupportTopInterface.caution: This is millimeter line spacing, not vertical separation or percent fill.

profile-settings:treeSupportTopZDistance.meaning: Conventional tree variant: Vertical clearance between the support top and the model above it.
profile-settings:treeSupportTopZDistance.when_to_change: Use when overhang undersides are too rough or supports bond too strongly.
profile-settings:treeSupportTopZDistance.effect: Increasing usually aids removal but gives less support; decreasing moves the support closer.
profile-settings:treeSupportTopZDistance.caution: The achievable gap is affected by layers; verify the actual sliced contact rather than just the input number.
profile-settings:treeSupportTopZDistance.status: Installed schema/help supports this explanation; not physically print-validated.

profile-settings:treeSupportUseIndepende.when_to_change: Use to tune support efficiency while preserving the model's layer schedule.
profile-settings:treeSupportUseIndepende.effect: Enabled uses the support minimum/maximum height range; disabled follows the ordinary coupled schedule.
profile-settings:treeSupportUseIndepende.caution: Installed help excludes Organic trees from this option. Verify contact interfaces still line up.

profile-settings:treeSupportWallCount.meaning: Conventional tree variant: Number of wall loops around each tree-support cross-section.

profile-settings:treeSupportWallCount.caution: This is not a vertical layer count. A second loop only appears where the geometry can fit it.
